slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether an aircraft can carry only one bomb per trip or what the per-trip carrying capacity is. Turn 10 is only a vague catch-all about additional constraints and does not clearly target this hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to maximize the probability that at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is it to guarantee that at least two are destroyed with certainty?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked about the objective and specifically whether it is to maximize the probability that at least two key parts are destroyed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each bomb drop requires a separate round trip, implying one bomb per aircraft trip.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether an aircraft can carry only one bomb per trip, but then assumed separate trips per bomb in the READY_TO_MODEL fuel calculation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 one-bomb-per-trip/carrying-capacity slot remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so the stop was premature.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the P0 objective and several fuel/probability modeling details, but it failed to ask about the P1 one-bomb-per-trip constraint and silently assumed separate round trips per bomb when declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
